For stronger cleaning, use a pH-balanced leather cleaner designed for finished leather (test first). Avoid harsh chemicals no alcohol-based cleaners, solvents, strong detergents, or abrasive materials. Condition periodically once every 6 to 12 months, apply a leather conditioner and wipe off excess. Address spills quickly blot, don't rub; allow to air-dry naturally. Protect from extremes avoid direct sunlight, heat sources, and humidity changes
